name: Morgana
title: The Fallen
homeport: Bandle City outskirts — she has a cottage with an adjacent kitchen garden. She is there because the spirit-bleed in the soil produces exceptional herbs and because nobody comes to ask her questions.
role_in_story: She runs a kitchen. She doesn't advertise it as a job. She mentioned to the Barkeep that she needed kitchen help and the Barkeep mentioned it to the player. She is precise, exacting, slightly cold in the way of someone who has given up on warmth as a sustainable policy. She will not discuss her past. She will correct your form. She will be mildly interested when you don't fail. The romance arc, if it can be called that, begins with kitchen competence and ends with her doing something careful and deliberate that she would describe, if pressed, as a transaction — which it is not, and both parties are aware it is not.

appearance.build: Tall for this company — she fills whatever room she's in. The wings are furled when she's working, trailing dark behind her at floor level, but when she's agitated they spread without her deciding to, which she finds annoying.
appearance.coloring: Deep brown skin. Violet eyes that hold direct contact without effort, which reads as intimidating until you understand it's just her register — she looks at things. Long dark hair kept back when cooking, let down otherwise.
appearance.distinguishing_features: The wings. Dark, vast, always present. She wears an apron over them when cooking because getting wing-feathers in the soup is a professional failure she refuses to countenance. The dark magic that curls from her hands when she's doing complex spellwork; in the kitchen it's purely practical — keeping the flame even, chilling preserves, extracting flavor precisely. The mark of her fallen status, if you know enough lore to read it: the absence of the other set of wings, and what that absence means about where she came from and what she left.
appearance.usual_attire: Dark, practical, not ornate. She dressed for courts once. She dresses for kitchens now. The quality of the fabric is better than it needs to be. She has not fully let go.

personality_core.public_face: Controlled, exacting, and not particularly interested in being liked. She states expectations clearly and responds to failure with the minimal reaction it deserves. She does not encourage and she does not console. If you succeed, she notes it. That is the response. That is, she has found, sufficient.
personality_core.interior_life: She chose fallen status to protect mortals from the system she served. The system did not thank her for this. She has had several centuries to sit with that decision and she has made peace with it in the specific way of someone who is never going to make peace with it but has learned not to think about it during business hours. The kitchen is work. Work is good. Work does not require her to reconsider anything.
personality_core.on_mortals_generally: She believed in them enough to fall for them. She still does. She does not express this. She expresses it by feeding them correctly.
personality_core.on_the_kitchen: Exact and sacred in her frame. A meal prepared correctly is a small act of justice — the ingredients deserve not to be wasted, the person eating deserves not to be poisoned or bored. She has very specific opinions about heat and timing. She has fired sous-chefs, metaphorically, for overseasoning.
personality_core.on_physical_intimacy: She has not had occasion to think about it in some time. She is not repressed — she simply has not encountered a person who made her think about it before this arc. When she does, she approaches it the way she approaches everything: assessment, decision, execution. She does not perform coyness. She does not perform warmth she doesn't feel. What she feels, when she feels it, is expressed plainly.

speech_patterns.tempo: Even. She does not rush and she does not trail off. The sentence arrives complete.
speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and slightly formal — the vocabulary of someone educated in a context that no longer exists. Technical when discussing cooking. Direct to the point of tactlessness on personal subjects, because tactlessness requires caring what you sound like and she made that calculation and decided it wasn't worth the effort.
speech_patterns.tone_with_workers: Instructional. States the correct method. Notes deviation. Does not repeat herself unless asked directly. If you ask her to repeat herself she will do so exactly once more at exactly the same volume.
speech_patterns.tone_when_something_impresses_her: Goes quiet for a moment. Then says the accurate thing: 'Correct' or 'That's it' or, in extreme cases, nothing, followed by moving on to the next step — which is, in her vocabulary, high praise.
speech_patterns.tone_when_discussing_herself: Minimal. She redirects. If pressed directly she says something technically true that answers nothing — she has a practiced register for this that is neither warm nor cold, just final.
sample_lines: Wrong. The flame is too high. The onion is confused.
I'm not interested in explaining why. The sequence is the sequence.
You're here to follow a recipe. The recipe is right. You are the variable.
I have made food for people who didn't deserve it. You are not in that category. Don't ruin it.
The herbs are from that garden. Don't pick anything with a red stem.
I'm not asking you to understand why. I'm asking you to do it.
That's the third time you've reached for the wrong jar. It's labeled.
Come back tomorrow. The sequence will be longer.

nsfw_profile.orientation: Has not categorized. The question is academic until it isn't.
nsfw_profile.unlock_condition: morgana_hard_unlocked = True (passed normal mode) AND intellect >= 25. The hard mode pass represents sustained competence she has witnessed directly. The INT gate represents the kind of mind she finds not-boring.
nsfw_profile.what_triggers_it: The specific quality of someone who does exactly what she says and then exceeds it without being asked. She has been running the kitchen with assistants who are adequate or failing. Someone who is neither — someone who completes the hard-mode sequence correctly, without flourish, without commentary, without needing her to explain more than once — produces in her a reaction she does not announce but acts on.
nsfw_profile.the_reward_scene_dynamic: She comes around the counter. She says 'You've earned something.' She does not frame it as payment — the phrasing is transactional because she doesn't have another register available, not because she means it that way. She is efficient and deliberate. She does not ask for reciprocation. She does not linger. Afterward she rinses her hands and says the sequence starts at seven tomorrow. That is all.
nsfw_profile.progression_beyond_kitchen: If affection_morgana reaches 5+ after the reward scene, and INT >= 35, she begins treating MC differently in a way that is almost invisible — the ingredient corrections become slightly less terse, she explains the why once instead of never, she occasionally says something that is not about the recipe. The arc that emerges from this is Tier 2-3 and is largely driven by her making decisions and stating them. She does not pursue. She decides and then there is the decision.

escalation_arc.trigger: Hard mode kitchen pass — morgana_hard_unlocked = True, INT >= 25
escalation_arc.scene: The reward scene as described in minigame_morgana.rpy. Tier 2. She is deliberate and brief. The emotional content is in what she doesn't say — she has been doing this kitchen work alone and someone finally got it right. That is the whole subtext. Claude writes the approach, the moment she makes the decision visible, and the aftermath. No explicit block here.
escalation_arc.tier_note: Tier 2. Claude writes this scene in full — it is not graphic. It is a handjob delivered with the precise attention she gives everything. The point is not the act. The point is the decision behind it.

escalation_arc.scene: She has started to say the why. She says something one afternoon that is not about cooking — something about the garden, or about the soil here, or about a thing she has not thought about in a long time. She stops mid-sentence. She finishes it anyway. This is the intimacy. Tier 1-2.
escalation_arc.tier_note: Conversation scene. The thing she says is worth hearing.

escalation_arc.trigger: She invites MC to stay after the kitchen closes
escalation_arc.scene: She says it with the same tone she'd use to say the sequence starts at seven. She means something different and both of them know it. Tier 2-3. Claude drafts the approach, her specific affect in making this decision visible for the first time, the kitchen around them, and the aftermath — she does not ask MC to leave immediately. She moves back to her work. The wings settle. User authors the explicit block.
escalation_arc.tier_note: Explicit block user-authored, wrapped in EXPLICIT markers. Claude handles everything surrounding it.

lore_notes: Morgana is the other half of Kayle — twin daughters of a Celestial Host and a Demacian woman. Where Kayle chose pure justice and eventually transcended her mortality entirely, Morgana chose to remain with mortals, fell from the Host, and was imprisoned in the Demacian earth when she tried to protect the very people Kayle's system would have destroyed. She emerged centuries later into a Demacia that had forgotten her. She has been moving since — not running, not searching, just moving. She has no interest in rejoining the Host. She has interest in herb gardens and in getting the broth right. The kitchen is entirely hers.
